The '''Geillia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Geillian ale]] beverage.<ref name="Wretched">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Geillian ale]]|system=Geillia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Geillia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-6.<ref name="TEA" />
